name: A00_5_the_exile_rider_covers_only_that_spell
notes: Printed: '[-2]: You may cast target red instant or sorcery card from your graveyard. If that spell would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead.' Step 1: the -2 casts the graveyard Shock at the opponent (2 damage, paid by tapping a Mountain); it is exiled instead of going to the graveyard. Step 2: a second Shock, cast from the hand the usual way (the other Mountain), is a different spell and goes to the graveyard as any spell does. Opponent 20 -> 18 -> 16. Loyalty 5 -> 3.
